results.title: Dense 5-region enterprise dashboard, 30+ items, connectors, vectors
results.requirement: A dense but legal screen compiles, stays on canvas, and emits geometry that matches its resolved boxes.
results.knownIssue: PARTLY FIXED. The emitted-vs-resolved mismatches are gone — thirteen of them, all of the form 'nav-0 is emitted 64 wide but its resolved box is 168 wide' — by making hug components compute their size once (A1-hug) and by emitting graphics in parent-relative coordinates (A7-coords). Two containment failures remain. (1) A vector placed by the radial/overshoot path resolves outside its parent region: 'trace-1 escapes topology (216,80 32x32 in 232,96 1208x620)'. (2) A five-region shell stacks inspector and timeline below the canvas. Issue #12 additional issue 5: fixed/fill/hug, explicit top/bottom and below/rightOf relations combine into oversize regions and silent position drift; a single authoritative geometry model is still needed.

results.title: Content containment: long text, dense grid, padding and gap extremes
results.requirement: Padding is honoured and overflow is reported rather than silently drawn outside the region.
results.knownIssue: Two failures, both about the grid layout ignoring the box it was handed. (1) `padding: 48` is not honoured — the first cell resolves at x=0 in a region whose origin is x=0, so the 48px inset is simply absent. (2) A 3-column grid of six cells places them at y=678, 707 and 736 inside a region 646px tall, and no violation reports the overflow. Issue #12 additional issue 6: 'content exceeds its region bounds (map region 850x600 while content reached y=699)' — acceptance criterion 4 asks that overflow be contained or explicitly allowed, and currently it is neither.
